heading: Deploy
cmds: kubectl apply -f pvc.yaml; sleep 3; kubectl -n production-webapp get pvc
kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml -f service.yaml; kubectl -n production-webapp rollout status deploy/web-app -
kubectl apply -f hpa.yaml; sleep 45; kubectl -n production-webapp get hpa

heading: Deploy
cmds: kubectl -n production-webapp describe deploy web-app | grep -E "Replicas|StrategyType|Liveness|Readiness|Start

heading: Persistence
cmds: POD=$(kubectl -n production-webapp get pods -l app=web-app -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}"); echo "pod
POD=$(kubectl -n production-webapp get pods -l app=web-app -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}"); kubectl -

heading: Service
cmds: kubectl -n production-webapp get endpoints web-service; kubectl -n production-webapp run svc-check --image=cur

heading: Hpa
cmds: for i in 1 2 3 4; do kubectl -n production-webapp run load-generator-$i --image=busybox:1.36 --restart=Never -

heading: Hpa
cmds: kubectl -n production-webapp get hpa; kubectl -n production-webapp get pods -l app=web-app; kubectl -n product

heading: Hpa
cmds: kubectl -n production-webapp describe hpa web-app-hpa | sed -n "/Metrics:/,\$p"

heading: Hpa
cmds: kubectl -n production-webapp delete pod -l run --wait=true; sleep 45; kubectl -n production-webapp get hpa; ku
